title: Demand Response Programs — Incentive Payment Methods, Timing and Minimums
content:
**Payment terms.** Incentives earned under the Demand Response Programs are paid by the method and at the time shown for each program. A balance below the program's payout minimum is not paid; it carries to the next payout.

| Program | Payment method | When earned incentives are paid | Smallest balance paid out |
|---|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | Bill credit | On the next regular bill after the event | $1.00 |
| Smart Thermostat Rewards | Bill credit | On the first regular bill after activation for the bonus, and after the season ends for the seasonal incentive | $1.00 |
| AC Cycling Program | Bill credit | On each regular bill in the participation credit months, and on the first regular bill after activation for the bonus | $1.00 |
| Home Battery Dispatch | Check | After the season ends | $25.00 |
| Commercial Capacity Bidding Program | Bill credit | Monthly on the regular bill after each program month | $1.00 |
| Base Interruptible Program | Bill credit | Monthly on the regular bill after each program month | $1.00 |

**By payment method**

- *Bill credit* — Peak Time Rebate, Smart Thermostat Rewards, AC Cycling Program, Commercial Capacity Bidding Program and Base Interruptible Program, each with a $1.00 minimum.
- *Check* — Home Battery Dispatch only, after the season ends, with a $25.00 minimum.

**Minimum illustrations (hypothetical balances)**

| Program | Hypothetical balance at payout time | Paid now? |
|---|---|---|
| Peak Time Rebate | $0.75 | No — below $1.00; carries |
| Peak Time Rebate | $1.00 | Yes — equal to the minimum |
| Home Battery Dispatch | $24.99 | No — below $25.00; carries |
| Home Battery Dispatch | $25.00 | Yes — equal to the minimum |
